reasons: No AGPL or SSPL dependency was found in either lockfile.

scope_notes: Tier: deployed backend. The Docker images (Dockerfile.tee for tag latest, Dockerfile.cherrypick otherwise) are built and pushed to Google Artifact Registry by .github/workflows/artifacts.yml, which then calls a Cloud Function; the image runs tee-server (Rust) plus the Node sidecars.

Branches: pull requests go to staging, and staging is merged into main by separate pull requests (last: #55 on 2026-08-31). deploy.yml builds on push to main (environment PRD, tag latest) and on push to staging (environment STG, tag stg). The scanned commit is staging plus two commits: removal of instance-deps/ and the LICENSE file. Cargo.lock and jwt-input-generator/package-lock.json are identical on main and staging. Until staging is merged, main still has no LICENSE and still holds instance-deps/socat and instance-deps/vsock-proxy.

In the deployed image: Cargo.lock (tee-server, built with --locked) and jwt-input-generator/package-lock.json (npm ci --omit=dev, spawned by src/attestation/bootstrap.rs via tsx). The jwt-input-generator is a runtime sidecar of the service, not a helper tool.

Not lockfile-backed and not in the image: signature-verifier/ is a zero-dependency Node script (node:crypto, node:fs, node:path) copied into the image; no manifest. Dev-only Rust dependency: tempfile (tests).

Earlier report, poseidon-rs GPL-3.0 through babyjubjub-rs: true. poseidon-rs 0.0.8 is a dependency of babyjubjub-rs 0.0.11 (direct dependency) and is compiled into tee-server (KYC verifier); GPL is acceptable on a backend, so it is a flag.

Earlier report, snarkjs stack GPL-3.0 in jwt-input-generator: true, 16 lockfile entries (snarkjs, circomlibjs, ffjavascript and others) come from @zk-email/jwt-tx-builder-helpers 0.1.0 via @zk-email/helpers 6.4.2. They are installed in the image but the import path index.ts uses does not load them (traced in the published package files).

Earlier report, rapidsnark LGPL-3.0: true. Submodule rapidsnark at 998383787ee86bcb6bfb8741e9a638d203c08eae (URL git@github.com:iden3/rapidsnark.git), compiled from source in both images and run as a separate process. Its own submodules: ffiasm (LGPL-3.0 by GitHub licence detection), circom_runtime (Apache-2.0), json (MIT), pistache (Apache-2.0); not listed separately by the scanner.

Earlier report, committed binaries: instance-deps/ held socat (383 KB ELF, GPL tool; removed on staging by PR #56), vsock-proxy (9.7 MB static x86-64 ELF built from the Nitro Enclaves vsock_proxy source; no licence or version recorded) and run.sh. No file referenced the folder and no Dockerfile copied it; they were leftovers from an earlier AWS Nitro setup (added in d805c6e, 2025-02-17). The folder is removed at the scanned commit.

Apt packages in the image (installed with apt-get, not in a lockfile): include socat (GPL), libgmp-dev (LGPL), and the Node install from nodesource. The image is pushed to a Google Artifact Registry. The repo owner states the TEE images are not shared outside the company; the registry's visibility was not inspected.
